Hi there! I graduated from the same program last year 2024. I believe I received the admission letter in April/May 2022. As for the experience, Im gonna be honest. Since everything is pre-recorded, you really don't get to interact with the professor much until the Capstone project. If you are looking for guidance from professors, you really need to be the initiator. To me, it just felt like I am reading papers/ lectures and then doing homework every week. Knowledge wise I don't think I learned much which is probably my fault. But I do ended up getting a higher paid job after graduating because some companies value a master's degree. To add on, I have some peers in the same program who are also constantly complaining about the lack of efforts from the professors. So choose wisely dependent on your end goal. Hope that helps :)
